issues.detail: The Greek 'παρελθων' (parelthōn) is a perfect participle meaning 'having passed by' or 'having gone by.' The Vietnamese translation 'đến' (came) reverses the direction/action of the movement.
The Greek 'ο χιλιαρχος' (ho chiliarchos) is a title for a commander of a thousand. The Vietnamese translation omits this specific rank/title, rendering only the name.
